name: Magga
summary: Near the Den in the Valley of Trials, Magga welcomes new arrivals. The orc lives in Durotar and greets Horde travelers beginning their journey through the valley.

sections.title: A Welcoming Face in the Valley of Trials
sections.body: Young orcs and Darkspear trolls first meet the wider world in the Valley of Trials. Near the Den, Magga greets those arriving in the valley. Trainers and recruits keep busy nearby, while Magga helps bring the small camp together.

faq.answer: Magga is an orc civilian near the Den in the Valley of Trials, Durotar, where she welcomes new Horde travelers.

faq.q: What is Magga's connection to Innkeeper Grosk?
faq.answer: Magga has no special tie to Innkeeper Grosk. She stays in the Valley of Trials, while Innkeeper Grosk keeps the inn at Razor Hill, where travelers can find food, drink, and a place to bind their hearthstones.
Magga receives the 'Welcome!' errand. Adventurers bring her a Valley of Trials Gift Voucher, and she welcomes them to Azeroth with a small companion as a gift.

angles.text: As a fresh Horde recruit in the harsh Valley of Trials, you receive a reassuring welcome to Durotar from Magga.
